title: Surreal Paddleboard Fantasy
description: Two women stand on a pink paddleboard floating on swirling blue water. One is visibly pregnant in a blue swimsuit while the other stands behind her holding a staff, as a small black dragon flies above and a large blue dragon coils around a castle in the background.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene shows two women standing on a bright pink paddleboard floating in the middle of swirling blue water. The woman in front is pregnant, wearing a blue one-piece swimsuit and high heels, while the woman behind her holds a tall staff. A small black dragon with pink wings flies in the sky to the left, and a massive blue serpent dragon coils around a dark castle on a rocky mountain to the right. The background has a gradient sky from blue to black with glowing pink spirals and concentric circles, creating a dreamlike atmosphere.
